pack: Lomdim BeKef — 2D game asset pack v2.1

canvas.rule: Boy and girl share identical scale, canvas and baseline. Never rescale one alone.

facing: Right-facing side art only — mirror horizontally in engine for left movement.

sheets.notes: Identical frame geometry to nir_kippah — hot-swappable skin.

animationSets: idle_front (1), idle_back (1), idle_side (1), walk_front (6), walk_back (6), walk_side (6), carry_front (6), carry_back (6), carry_side (6), pickup (3), drop (3), celebrate (4)

frameOrder.walk: 01 contact (right foot forward) · 02 down (lowest hip) · 03 passing (right leg straight, left leg swinging past) · 04 contact (left foot forward) · 05 down · 06 passing — 6-frame loop
frameOrder.carry: same 6-frame cycle as walk, both hands holding the object at chest height, torso leaning back 4°
frameOrder.pickup: 01 reach down · 02 grasp at ground · 03 rise holding — no loop
frameOrder.drop: 01 hold at chest · 02 lower and place · 03 release and stand — no loop
frameOrder.celebrate: 01 crouch anticipation · 02 launch, arms opening · 03 apex, fists high · 04 land, arms wide — no loop
frameOrder.idle: single frame per direction; engine adds a 2% breathing scale over 2.4s

export.shadow: soft contact ellipse baked into every frame, 18% opacity
export.text: no text baked into any asset
export.trim: do NOT trim — uniform frames keep the baseline aligned
